title: EAP message reliable transport procedure initiation by the network

entities.name: EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reliable transport of EAP messages between AMF and UE during authentication.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to UE to initiate EAP authentication procedure.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information element containing the EAP-request message to be sent to the UE.

entities.name: ngKSI IE
entities.description: Information element containing the ngKSI value selected during authentication.

entities.name: ABBA IE
entities.description: Information element with length 2 and contents 0000H as specified in subclause 9.11.3.10.

entities.name: T3560
entities.description: Timer started by AMF when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that initiates the EAP message reliable transport procedure.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message and processes EAP message and ABBA.

relations.description: AMF initiates the EAP message reliable transport procedure.
Procedure includes sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP message IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains ngKSI IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains ABBA IE.
AMF starts timer T3560 when sending AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
UE handles EAP message received in EAP message IE.
UE handles ABBA of the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.
